rationale: The committee needs a synthesis in four months, which a rapid review can deliver with stated shortcuts: one screener with a 20 percent check, English only, and abstract-level appraisal for most records. The evidence is narrow and heterogeneous: adherence measures disagree (c2), harms and dose intensity move together (c3, c4), and costs rest on one budget range (c5). The review is narrowed to pharmacist-led follow-up in adults starting oral agents and reports its strands separately. Methods follow rapid review guidance; reporting follows PRISMA with the shortcuts declared.
alternatives: Full evidence synthesis with duplicate screening and full appraisal (refused: cannot finish before the funding round)
Local audit of the centre's own admissions (refused: the centre's data are context only and not part of the review)
Fund the service without a review (refused: the committee asked for the evidence)
guidelines: PRISMA 2020 with declared rapid review shortcuts
whyNotMoreComplex: A full synthesis with a new model of costs would take longer than the committee can wait and would still rest on a handful of small studies.

decision.statement: Run a rapid review narrowed to pharmacist-led follow-up for adults starting oral anticancer agents, reporting harms and dose intensity, adherence by measurement method, and pharmacist time and money as separate strands for the February 2027 funding round, once the search hits that were reported but not ingested have been retrieved.
decision.question: What evidence should the committee receive on a pharmacist-led follow-up service for oral anticancer agents?

criteria.text: Effects are measured inconsistently and costs rest on a single range, so strands reported separately are the useful product.
A current review already reports these strands separately for pharmacist-led follow-up.

gates.requirement: Library design and running of the searches
gates.evidence: Library request CCL-2026-58 dated 2026-09-10, supplied by the investigator

gates.requirement: Pharmacist time for the review until 29 January 2027
gates.evidence: Pharmacy manager approval PM-2026-33, supplied by the investigator

gates.requirement: Retrieval of the search hits that the provider reported but did not return

alternatives: Fund the service without a review
decision.note: Rests on ledger claims c1 to c5 from the eight retrieved records; the retrieval gate stays unknown until the remaining hits are retrieved or shown to be irrelevant.

summary: Narrowed rapid review recommended; the decision waits on retrieving the rest of the search.
